summary.name: wywmysweetie
summary.one_liner: wywmysweetie is an independent fan AI video tool that turns one adult photo into a short 9:16 vertical dance/Halloween half-face makeup reel, sold per video from $8.88.
use_cases: making a TikTok, Reels or Shorts trend post from one photo
creating a Halloween makeup meme video
turning a pet or duo photo into a short dance reel
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a one-photo workflow: upload one adult photo (full body to feet recommended), click Create with no prompt to write, and receive a roughly 10 to 13 second 9:16 vertical MP4 in a few minutes. The page says it uses Seedance and a locked template so the person's face stays recognizable. Pricing is per render: $8.88 buys 500 credits for one 720p video, 480p uses 375 credits, and larger credit packs ($16.99 and $29.90) are listed. Failed renders restore credits. Photos are said to stay local for preview and render through a short-lived private link; the page says source photos are not kept as a public gallery. The page is inconsistent about the clip length (~10s in some places, ~12s and ~13s in others) and about the Halloween versus dance-trend framing.
notable: One photo in, locked template, no prompt required
Pay-per-video credits with no subscription; failed renders refund credits
Explicitly an independent fan tool, not affiliated with Marvel, Sony, or the original song owners
Restricted to adults who consented; labeling as AI is requested
caveats: Paid only: from $8.88 per 720p render, with 480p at 375 credits
Only one locked template; no custom prompts
Render download links expire, so the MP4 must be saved promptly
Adults who agreed only; no children, celebrities or strangers
